fact: On 12 August 2026 the ministers of Nigeria and Burkina Faso agreed in Ouagadougou on the principle of a direct interconnection between Nigeria's Project BRIDGE fibre backbone and Burkina Faso's borders, with routes via Niger and Benin still to be evaluated.
title: Bosun Tijani and Aminata Zerbo anchor a Nigeria-Burkina fibre axis on Nigeria's 90,000 km Project BRIDGE backbone
